yamlCheck.dateAnchor: Only early November (later loosely mid November) is spoken. The year and precise opening day are YAML-only; conditional on November 8, the second dawn is November 10.
yamlCheck.explanation: At least two completed overnight transitions separate the reunion, sailing day, and rescue day; YAML allows only one. The final return to Hamri has no stated duration, so an exact total for the closing interval cannot be proved. This open ending cannot remove the two established transitions.
